name: B – Trend + momentum (asset classes)
plan: From 26 Oct 2026 (user's go 2026-10-24; until then B traded the hourly ML system with a brake and caps, now in paper/B/): at each month's last close, rank 8 asset-class ETFs (SPY, EFA, EEM, TLT, IEF, GLD, DBC, VNQ) by 12-month return and hold the top 3, a third each, only those above their 10-month average (else SHY, the cash stand-in); bought at the next open, no stops. Market data only. Backtest 2007-2026: 8.7% a year, Sharpe 0.73, worst fall -17%, vs SPY 11.1%, 0.63, -55%: reports/2026-10-20-trend-momentum/. Starts with B's paper equity at the switch.
